additional_candidate_checks.finding: Plain boneless round/thigh products are real mainstream retail, but none of these exact product records establishes the narrower top/inside round cut. The 701640 description calls the whole round the upper leg, which is not evidence that this is specifically its inside/top subdivision. Category explanatory copy and third-party declarations of possible manufactured cuts are not a product match. No qualifying exact cut evidence established across the five baseline chains. Do not import as AVAILABLE or assume frozen/thawed provenance from chilled meat.

Lenta PAN ASIAN light has no explicit reduced-salt claim; light naming alone does not establish low sodium. Magnit Sen Soy light product explicitly describes low salt but is bound to Krasnodar and cannot be qualified by generic SPB chain presence. A SPB classic sauce page displays a light variant selector but the selected actual product is classic; this is not evidence that the reduced-salt variant is listed for that store. No qualifying exact low-sodium form established in reviewed baseline-chain results.

scope: Correction-pass six canonical purchase concepts for Oven Fried Fish, Baked Lentils Casserole, and Orange Pork Chops. One-based filename:N references observations[N-1]. Market compatibility is not momentary store stock. No production retailer integration, prices, nutrition, recipe conversion, or unrestricted rights claims.
exclusions: Official product pages explicitly bound to Moscow, Krasnodar, Rostov or another non-SPB/LO city were not accepted; this includes multiple Magnit tilapia results and Perekrestok categories.
Expired retailer promotional PDFs were excluded, including old Pyaterochka cheese offers and Perekrestok fish flyers.
Breadcrumbs listed only as an ingredient of ready fishcakes were not evidence for standalone breadcrumbs.
Okey Orenburg cheese and Murmansk dried tomato pages were excluded for wrong region and/or form.
Salted Pikanta passata, processed cheddar, smoked or marinated pork loin, canned lentils, and culinary preparation descriptors were not accepted as the selected purchase concepts.

Browser errors and missing qualifying results mean evidence not established in that search, never product absence. User reviews, health claims and generic web assertions were not used as primary product evidence.

region_reviews.finding: Current official vegetables category delivery section expressly lists Saint Petersburg among served cities.
Current official X5 delivery operation page identifies Pyaterochka and Perekrestok stores; current picker locations include Saint Petersburg.
The two accepted official product URLs contain shop IDs and explicitly display Saint Petersburg store addresses; no separate generic chain-presence inference is needed.

observations.wording: Тилапия филе (из замороженного сырья) Премиум ЛЕНТА FRESH, весовая
observations.notes: Current official neutral page indexed today. Plain raw thawed tilapia fillet, sole ingredient tilapia; not cooked fish or a prepared breaded product. Source explicitly permits fresh or frozen-and-thawed tilapia. No yield conversion.

Current official neutral page indexed two days ago. Raw frozen fillets, tilapia and drinking-water glaze. An explicitly source-permitted frozen-and-thawed alternative; not a second qualifying chain. No glaze-to-edible mass conversion.

Current official neutral page indexed yesterday. Plain wheat breadcrumbs intended for breading fish/meat/vegetables, not seasoned mix, panko-only concept, or breadcrumbs hidden inside a ready meal. Ordinary grocery purchase concept.

Current official neutral page indexed today. Plain dry whole green lentils; select whole lentils within source generic lentils, not canned cooked lentils or split red lentils requiring an unreviewed method change.

observations.notes: Current official neutral page indexed today. Ordinary natural semi-hard block cheddar made from milk, not processed cheese slices, cheese sauce, or reduced-fat cheese. Shredding is source preparation, not a required retail form. Dry-matter fat labeling is not converted to a recipe fat quantity.

observations.wording: Official cheese category lists Сыр Le Superbe Чеддер 50% БЗМЖ 150г.
observations.notes: Current search-indexed official region-neutral category, indexed three months ago; live open failed, so the underlying official category URL and exact product wording are retained for review. No city binding was shown. Separate current X5 official delivery-employment page identifies delivery from Pyaterochka and Perekrestok stores and picker operations in Saint Petersburg. Premium brand alone is not the plausibility basis: the ordinary Lenta Belarus-made cheddar corroborates a non-specialist canonical purchase concept.

observations.wording: Корейка свиная Премиум ЛЕНТА FRESH; raw chilled boneless pork loin, sole ingredient pork.
observations.notes: Current official neutral product indexed today and full attributes inspected: На кости — Нет; Режим охлаждения — Охлажденный; Часть туши — Корейка. Ordinary plain raw boneless loin can be selected for generic pork chops; not marinated pork, smoked loin, or a cooked product. Retain two source chops as counts; no invented slice thickness or mass. A stock-ended label is not treated as market absence or current availability.

observations.wording: Орегано (душица) KOTANYI измельченный, 8г; sole ingredient oregano, shelf-stable grocery seasoning.
observations.notes: Current official neutral product indexed two weeks ago. Standalone dried chopped herb in a spice packet, not fresh plant, sowing seeds, mixed Italian herbs, or oregano within a prepared sauce. Ordinary non-specialist seasoning. Five-chain queries also reviewed 5ka oregano, Perekrestok dried oregano, Okey oregano, Magnit oregano Saint Petersburg: other results were recipes, expired flyers, wrong-city pages, mixed seasoning or ready dishes, not qualifying product evidence. Supplemental classification RU_AVAILABLE. No health, price or nutrient claims imported.

observations.wording: Клубника замороженная BONVIDA, 1500г; sole ingredient клубника.
observations.notes: Current official neutral product indexed today. Frozen single-fruit strawberries with no added sugar in the declared complete ingredient list, not syrup, jam, fruit puree, ice cream or mixed berries. Ordinary frozen-grocery plausibility, retain source cup quantity without converting from retailer package weight. No health claims, current inventory, prices or consumer reviews imported.
